<!-- pr-reviewer: 693b3991d0496025dded58bafdf85a06d37213f8 -->
Needs changes before merge.

The selected tool settings and the tool library now have separate dock panels. The shared form keeps the existing command and undo paths. The before and after images load and show the change.

Requested before merge:

1. `crates/ui/src/egui_app/tool_library.rs:58`: Add the catalog filters required by [the maintainer's addition to #2002](https://github.com/NeoTech/Camcraft/issues/2002#issuecomment-6901331000). This loop shows every catalog entry. The panel has no tool type filter or name search field. Add an All types option and a name filter that ignores letter case. Apply both filters together. Keep their state out of the project and command history. Show a short message when no tool matches. Add structural tests for each filter, both filters together, and no match. The issue permits a follow-up if this work must be deferred, but no deferral or linked follow-up is recorded there. Record that split on the issue if it is needed before this PR closes #2002.

Local results:

Tested the PR with a clean trial merge of upstream/main `2f6de7c5b0eb7eb9053ce086a8e4705fc0776a78`. No GitHub runner was used. All commands ran in the foreground. The review used its own worktree and target directory.

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| Compile test targets for app, post, tools, and UI (`cargo test --no-run`) | Pass |
| Post full suite | 561 passed |
| Tools full suite | 89 passed |
| App unit tests | 327 passed, 1 ignored |
| App integration tests | 195 passed |
| UI unit tests, from `crates/ui` | 821 passed, 6 ignored |
| UI `waterjet_tool` | 1 passed |
| Clippy, all four crates, all targets, `-D warnings` | Pass |

App integration results: `cutting_data` 6; `machine_library` 11; `plasma_machine` 6; `post_serves_kind` 6; `post_serves_plasma` 1; `posting` 17; `project_roundtrip` 73; `stock_sim_document` 9; `tool_body` 12; `tool_cutting_rows` 11; `tool_law` 4; `tool_library` 14; `tool_list` 6; `tool_numbers` 6; `waterjet_machine` 13. Total: 1,994 passed, no failures, 7 ignored.

The gate dry run included incoming main changes in its plan. The review ran the touched suites listed above, not the full quick gate.

This is a safety-tier review because the diff includes the waterjet parent change. I repeated two mutations from the PR:

- Removed tab focus: `browser_library_door_and_tool_selection_focus_their_own_dock_tabs` failed at line 43, with `selecting a tool brings Properties in front of the catalog`. It passed after restoration.
- Removed the editor close on browser selection: the same test failed at line 49, with `browser selection closes the explicit tool editor`. It passed after restoration.

Both failures occurred during test execution. Both source files were restored to the trial merge. No NC, CL, or snapshot golden changed. No golden line review was needed. Native OS window interaction and release pixel snapshots were not tested.

The PR still depends on #2001. Merge the parent first. No other blocking finding was found.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Stopped at a same-logic conflict, as instructed. Nothing was pushed. The PR head remains 693b3991d0496025dded58bafdf85a06d37213f8.

The catalog filter finding is fixed locally in commit 3ff516d09c456811373b845e3bf58d5769d1ec74 on branch `fix-2029`.

- Type selection and All types reset: `catalog_type_filter_and_all_types_reset`.
- Case-insensitive name search: `catalog_name_filter_ignores_case_and_matches_substrings`.
- Combined filters and unchanged project/history: `catalog_filters_apply_together_without_changing_the_document_or_history`.
- Empty result and recovery: `catalog_no_match_shows_message_and_preserves_the_catalog`.

Five mutations failed during test execution. Each restoration passed. Quick gate passed with 3,449 tests passing and 16 ignored. Clippy passed for app, post, tools and UI, all targets, with warnings denied. These results precede the attempted main merge.

The PR became conflicting during validation. I ran `git merge upstream/main` at 17a8c6e7 and aborted it without resolving the hunk.

Conflict: `crates/ui/src/egui_app/pages.rs`, `tool_editor_window`, around line 453. This branch extracts the editor body into `tool_settings::contents(ui, state, true)`. Main changes Apply in the original body to disable it when a waterjet recipe has `torch_refusal()`, from c37d083c. This is a refactor of logic main changed in place, including a refusal check. The instruction says to stop here instead of guessing.

The conflict needs reconciliation before a pushed head can receive re-review. No labels or ready state were changed.

Fixed the catalog filter finding from the latest review.

- The type dropdown includes All types. Pin: `catalog_type_filter_and_all_types_reset`.
- The name filter matches substrings and ignores letter case. Pin: `catalog_name_filter_ignores_case_and_matches_substrings`.
- Both filters apply together. They do not change the saved project or command history. Pin: `catalog_filters_apply_together_without_changing_the_document_or_history`.
- An empty result shows a short message. Clearing the filter restores the catalog rows. Pin: `catalog_no_match_shows_message_and_preserves_the_catalog`.

Merged `upstream/main` at `17a8c6e7` with a merge commit. The shared settings form retains main's waterjet Apply refusal.
Pins: `waterjet_properties_apply_preserves_recipe_refusal` and `waterjet_recipe_apply_refuses_invalid_and_accepts_valid_recipe`.

Six mutations failed during test execution. Each restoration passed. Removing the Apply refusal failed both the Properties and editor window tests.

Validation at the new head:
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: passed; 946 tests passed, 7 ignored.
- UI clippy, all targets, with `-D warnings`: passed.

New head: `a8b52ca3687c159d4763b13889ce31ad558846bf`.
The PR stays in draft. No labels changed. No screenshots, logs, or review evidence were committed.

Please re-review this head.

<!-- pr-reviewer: a8b52ca3687c159d4763b13889ce31ad558846bf -->
Ready for the maintainer to merge.

The earlier catalog filter finding is resolved. The type dropdown includes All types. The name filter ignores letter case and matches substrings. Both filters apply together. They leave the document and command history unchanged. An empty result shows a message. Four structural tests cover these requirements from the maintainer.

The before and after screenshots load and show the Properties change. The shared form preserves main's Apply/Add commands and waterjet recipe refusal. Tool selection and library navigation use separate dock tabs. No dependency or build script changed.

Local results:

The review used `.claude/worktrees/review-2029` with its own target directory. The trial merge with upstream/main `17a8c6e7608bb7078f75ec335361839712e51425` reported already up to date. No GitHub runner was used. All commands ran in the foreground.

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main --dry-run` | Pass |
| `cargo test -p camcraft-ui --no-run` | Pass |
| UI lib tests, from `crates/ui` | 834 passed, 6 ignored |
| All 12 mapped UI integration suites | 112 passed, 1 ignored |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings` | Pass |

Integration counts: boundary 3; boundary_picks 6; feedback 6; fixtures 7; gpu_render 11 passed and 1 ignored; machine 6; models 4; operations 31; shell 21; sinker_setup 2; theme_files 14; waterjet_tool 1. Total: 946 passed, 7 ignored, no failures.

I applied the safety-tier checks because the shared form edits tool geometry and retains the waterjet refusal. I repeated two mutations locally:

- Enabled Apply unconditionally. Both waterjet refusal tests failed during execution at `tests/waterjet_recipe.rs:80` and `:126`. After restoration, all four tests selected by `waterjet_` passed.
- Removed the editor close on browser selection. `browser_library_door_and_tool_selection_focus_their_own_dock_tabs` failed during execution at `tests/tool_properties.rs:49`. It passed after restoration.

The mutation failures were:

```text
zero thickness keeps Apply disabled
Properties preserves the invalid waterjet recipe refusal
browser selection closes the explicit tool editor
```

Both files were restored. The worktree has no tracked changes. No NC, CL, or snapshot golden changed, so no changed golden lines required review.

Requested before merge: none.

Notes: Native OS window interaction and release pixel snapshots were not tested. The PR body retains its earlier stack note; the current head already contains the tested upstream/main.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Merged main to resolve conflicts (DELTA: hand-resolved), merge commit e0659a68f. Turned back to draft for the re-check.

Conflict: `crates/ui/src/egui_app/pages.rs` - this PR moved the tool editor body to `tool_settings.rs` and the preview to `tool_preview.rs`, while main edited both in place:
- #2026 (left-hand taps): the "Left-hand tap (posting unavailable)" check row is ported into `tool_settings.rs` (thread pitch block); main's `tap_hand_tests` module stays in `pages.rs` (it drives `tool_editor_window`).
- #2010 (body preview): "a body replaces the parameter holder" is ported into `tool_preview::draw`; main's `tests/tool_preview.rs` (unchanged) now hangs off `tool_preview.rs` through a `#[cfg(test)] draw_tool_preview` wrapper calling `draw(.., wide = true)`.

`git diff upstream/main --stat` lists only this PR's files. Targeted gate: `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` green (ui lib 857 passed incl. tap_hand_tests x2 and tool_preview_tests x4; 13 ui suites ok), `cargo clippy -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -D warnings` clean. Ready for a re-check (/resolve-conflicts check) - a delta review of the remerge-diff.
